name: RTB Panel Connector
author: rtbcom

sections.description:
Get your WooCommerce store ready for rtb.com Personalized Retargeting campaigns in a few clicks, with no developers needed. RTB Panel Connector installs the rtb.com tracking tags and lets you build your product feed from your published products.

Sign in with your rtb.com account in the setup wizard. The plugin retrieves your tracking configuration and adds the rtb.com tags to your store. Then click “Connect products” and approve read-only access to your products. rtb.com builds your product feed every day, so nothing has to be exported or uploaded.

You need an rtb.com account to use this plugin.

Key Features:

  • Seamless integration: Connects your WooCommerce store with the rtb.com panel effortlessly.
  • Secure authentication: All external requests are authenticated to ensure your data is safe and stored securely.
  • Transparent data handling: The plugin communicates with rtb.com services to authenticate your store and to load the rtb.com tracking pixel. See the External services section below for exactly what data is sent and when.
  • Automatic product feed: With your approval, rtb.com reads your published products via a read-only WooCommerce REST API key and builds your product feed daily. Nothing has to be exported or uploaded.
  • Easy setup: A setup wizard guides you through the configuration process.

External services

This plugin relies on external services provided by rtb.com to deliver its core functionality (authenticating your store, building your product feed, and loading the rtb.com marketing/tracking pixel). Below is what each service is, what data is sent, and when.

RTB Panel API (api-panel.rtb.com)

What is it?
The rtb.com advertiser panel API is used to authenticate your store against your rtb.com advertiser account and to retrieve the configuration (tagging hash and data center) required for tracking.

Which data is sent and when?
Your rtb.com panel login (e-mail) and password, together with your store URL, the plugin version, the WooCommerce version, the enabled WooCommerce REST API versions, and the store currency, are sent only when you submit your credentials in the plugin setup wizard during onboarding or re-authentication. No data is sent to this endpoint on regular front-end page views.

How to connect your product feed?
Right after you log in, the plugin requests the “Connect products” link from the rtb.com Panel API (sending only the login session token). When you click “Connect products” and approve the request on the standard WooCommerce “allow access” screen, WooCommerce creates a read-only REST API key for “rtb.com” and sends it directly to the rtb.com Panel API. The plugin itself never stores the key.

From then on, rtb.com servers use the key once a day to read your store name, store currency, product categories, and published products (name, description, price, sale price, stock status, images, categories, brand, SKU, and product identifiers such as GTIN and MPN) to build your product feed. You can revoke the key at any time in WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API.

RTB House Pixel / CreativeCDN (tags.creativecdn.com)

What is it?
The rtb.com tracking pixel, delivered from CreativeCDN enables marketing, analytics, and retargeting.

Which data is sent and when?
Once a tagging hash is configured, on every front-end page view, the visitor’s browser loads a script from tags.creativecdn.com and transmits the configured tagging hash and the selected data center, together with a visitor identifier and the e-commerce event data listed below.

Visitor identifier:

  • For visitors who are not logged in, a random anonymous ID (UUID4) is stored in the rtbpc_aid cookie and sent as “aid”.
  • For logged-in users, an MD5 hash of the user’s WordPress account e-mail address is sent as “uid”. The e-mail address itself is never sent.

E-commerce event data, depending on the page being viewed:

  • Home page view: the event type only.
  • Product category page view: the category name.
  • Product search results: the IDs of up to 5 products shown in the results.
  • Product page view: the product ID.
  • Add to cart: the ID of the added product.
  • Cart page view: the IDs of the products in the cart.
  • Checkout start: the event type only.
  • Order confirmation (conversion): the order ID, the order value, the order currency, and the IDs of the ordered products.

Please note: the rtbpc_aid cookie is created for every front-end visitor who is not logged in, on every page view, before any data is transmitted. It is set independently of the tracking configuration, so it is also stored before onboarding is completed or when no tagging hash is configured in that case, no data is sent to tags.creativecdn.com.

Both services are operated by rtb.com. Please review their terms and privacy policy before use:

  • Terms of Service: https://panel.rtb.com/woocommerce/termsandconditions
  • Privacy Policy: https://panel.rtb.com/woocommerce/privacypolicy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/rtb-panel-connector directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings, then the RTB Panel Connector screen to configure the plugin or follow the setup wizard.
sections.faq:
What are the requirements for this plugin?

  • WordPress – Version 6.4 or newer
  • WooCommerce – Version 6.7 or newer
  • PHP – Version 7.4 or newer

Where can I find more information?

Please visit the rtb.com website for more details.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Show why rtb.com refused the login instead of “Invalid API response.”

1.0.1

  • Send WooCommerce integration data on rtb.com login.
  • Align event product IDs with the feed and add category and listing events.
  • Always export brand and product type in the product feed.
  • Let RTB House build the product feed through the WooCommerce REST API.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
